hints.title: Bipartite Matching Modeling
hints.text: The problem is finding a maximum matching in a bipartite graph where boys and girls form two independent sets.

hints.title: Augmenting Paths Search
hints.text: For each boy, search for an available girl or recursively reassign a previously matched girl using depth search.

hints.title: Visited Set Tracking
hints.text: Maintain a visited array for girls during each augmenting path search to avoid cyclical reassignments.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedy selection without reassignment leads to sub-optimal matchings.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Augmenting path matching finds the maximum flow / maximum matching in O(m * n) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate applies standard Kuhn bipartite matching algorithm with depth search.
